tool_args.rationale: The signatures and branch guidance favor the coupled siphon-memory ODE. With five parameters and only five paid rows, identifiability and confirmation remain inadequate. The fine trajectory batch is the only relevant available probe and should add observations without buying the nuisance auxiliary.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Not listed in the available probe menu; moreover the pilot s_grad span is broad and reports no narrow collinearity.
Explicitly irrelevant to identifying the stated five-parameter coupled ODE.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled ODE from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows do not robustly identify five parameters or provide fresh confirmation; the guidance calls for at least eight rows.
